item.title: ¿Qué es MCP y por qué cambia todo en Microsoft Fabric? — Fri Jul 31, 11:00 AM
item.description:
Microsoft Reactor Toronto La IA ya no solo responde preguntas: ahora ejecuta acciones sobre tus datos.
En esta sesión introductoria entenderás qué es el Model Context Protocol (MCP), por qué se ha convertido en el estándar de la industria y cómo Microsoft lo está integrando en Fabric como base de su plataforma agéntica.
Veremos la arquitectura cliente-servidor de MCP, qué son los servidores Local y Remote de Fabric, y cómo un agente de IA puede descubrir y operar workspaces, lakehouses y pipelines usando lenguaje natural. Sin código todavía — el objetivo es que salgas con el mapa mental completo del ecosistema.
Source: Meetup: Microsoft Reactor Toronto

item.title: Best of Union Beats: K Stylez — Thu Aug 6, 11:30 AM — Union
item.description:
We’re bringing our favourite DJs from our indoor Union Beats program to the patio! Turn up your midday with the best beats in the city. Union Summer’s mid-day DJ sessions bring laid-back vibes and feel-good energy to the patio—perfect for a break in the sun. Whether you’re grabbing a bite, meeting friends, or just soaking it all in, our DJs are spinning the ultimate soundtrack to your day. K Stylez is a Toronto-based DJ whose early passion for music and instrumentation led him to pursue DJing professionally. Since 2015, he has built an international performance career, playing across Canada and abroad at clubs, festivals, and major cultural events. His experience includes performances at OVO Bounce 2019, A3C Festival in Atlanta, and numerous Afro-pop concerts and events. Known for his versatile sound and high-energy sets, K Stylez continues to represent Toronto’s global music influence on diverse stages.
Source: Union Station Toronto
